concepts.name: workspace
concepts.definition: A tenant whose members, requests, settings, and assets are isolated from other tenants.

concepts.name: request
concepts.definition: A durable workspace record for an intended print, with its source, requested quantity, and production state.

concepts.name: print copy
concepts.definition: One unit of a request assigned to a production status and counted in the queue.

concepts.name: board
concepts.definition: The workspace view that organizes active requests and their copies by production status.

concepts.name: queue
concepts.definition: The ordered copies awaiting or progressing through a production status.

concepts.name: printer
concepts.definition: A configured resin or filament machine profile used for assignment and estimates.

concepts.name: model
concepts.definition: The uploaded STL or 3MF file associated with a request when that request has one.

concepts.name: asset
concepts.definition: A stored original model, derived preview, thumbnail, cover, or recoverable file belonging to a workspace.

concepts.name: storage
concepts.definition: The workspace-configured backend that holds models and derived assets.

concepts.name: storage provider
concepts.definition: An external or local backend option that a workspace can configure for its assets.

concepts.name: operation
concepts.definition: A journaled asset change that can resume or recover after interruption.

concepts.name: requester
concepts.definition: A user who submits print requests and whose view and edits are limited by workspace policy.

concepts.name: workspace admin
concepts.definition: A workspace member allowed to manage that workspace and its settings.

concepts.name: settings
concepts.definition: Typed product configuration stored per workspace or per deployment in database key-value tables.

concepts.name: catalog
concepts.definition: Curated printer, resin, electricity, or equipment data used to seed or validate product choices.

concepts.name: asset store contract
concepts.definition: The common behavioral suite every local and remote asset store must satisfy.

concepts.name: overview
concepts.definition: The account-facing summary of subscription plan, limits, and current usage.
